about: Skeleton — the shape of what is coming, while it comes. Shapes that stand for the content (a line for text, a circle for an avatar, a block for an image), in the text colour at a tenth. Hidden from sc

shape.about: A line of text, a block (an image, a card) or a circle (an avatar).

lines.about: Lines of text; the last is shorter. Keep it to a few: not every line needs one.

width.about: Any CSS length. Text and blocks fill their box by default; a circle is 2.5rem.

height.about: A block's height, any CSS length (6rem by default).

animated.about: Breathe while waiting (stopped under reduced motion either way).
